assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 must not have a File Transfer Protocol (FTP) server package installed.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Verify RHEL 9 does not have an FTP server package installed with the following command:

$ sudo dnf list --installed | grep vsftpd

If the "vsftpd" package is installed, this is a finding.
